description: A muscular male warrior with an aggressive expression and short hair, wearing a traditional Japanese fighting hakama, bare-chested with arm bandages and battle tattoos on his torso and arms, realistic Mortal Kombat style
A lean male ninja in a full black bodysuit with a face mask covering everything except the eyes, wearing a ninja headband, with wrist gauntlets holding hidden blades, realistic Mortal Kombat style

A young archer hero in fantasy realistic style, wearing a green hooded cloak with leather adventurer hat, carrying a staff and bow on back, sword at waist, leather chest armor and boots, determined young face, T-pose full body front view, game character concept art

A large demonic bat creature in fantasy style, 2 meter wingspan spread in T-pose, dark purple leathery skin, red glowing eyes, sharp fangs visible, menacing fantasy monster concept art, full body front view
A small forest goblin in fantasy style, green skin, hunched posture, T-pose with arms spread, holding a wooden club, wearing tattered rags, menacing fantasy monster concept art, full body front view

A terrorist fighter wearing a black tactical vest and balaclava face mask, holding an assault rifle, realistic military style. The character stands in a T-pose with arms extended horizontally and palms facing down.
